reviewType: Source inspection and offline browser mocks only; no hosted requests or application workflows executed
credentialHandling: No browser credential reads. Existing same-origin browser cookies accompany requests automatically; never inspected or exported.
publicSamplePdf: Only the versioned public templates/pcydo-move-application-form.pdf build artifact is fetched; no private documents.

offlineChecks.meaning: All requests stay in the bounded read-only allowlist; mock artifact mismatch remains FAIL.

offlineChecks.check: public canary stops without disclosing contents

limitations: No independent proof of service-worker bypass; operator must report DevTools Bypass for network.
Counters cover requests initiated by the checker only. Existing application background activity is outside scope.
The bounded literal/canary scan is not an exhaustive secrets audit.
No hosted or owner-smoke result can be inferred from these mocks.
